name: addressing-05-fail-safe-multi
brief: Three launch ads for the Q3 clinic campaign, one per account.

expected.ask: Which of the designs is this for — one of them, a few, or all of them?

why: The multi-document fail-safe INVERTS the single-document one (spec §3.5): an unparseable judgment on three artifacts must not fan out three runs on a guess, so the engine asks its own sentence and dispatches nothing.
